beats.action: Noah presents Aaliyah with a giant, strangely shaped gift-wrapped box.

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, I got you a random Tuesday surprise.

beats.action: Aaliyah opens the box to reveal a high-end, heavy-duty industrial vacuum sealer.

dialogue.speaker: Aaliyah
dialogue.text: Noah, is this an industrial food sealer?

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: It keeps your leftovers fresh for literal decades.

beats.action: Aaliyah lifts the heavy machine, clearly unimpressed.

dialogue.speaker: Aaliyah
dialogue.text: I wanted flowers, not a crime scene cleanup tool.

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Think of the meal prep efficiency, babe!

beats.action: Noah pulls out a roll of bags and holds one up expectantly.

dialogue.speaker: Aaliyah
dialogue.text: If you seal my shoes, we are breaking up.

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.text: Wait, I actually already sealed your remote.

beats.action: Aaliyah grabs the sealed remote and tries to press buttons through the plastic.

dialogue.speaker: Aaliyah
dialogue.text: I am putting you in this bag next.

music_prompt: Upbeat, breezy lo-fi hip hop with a light comedic piano melody.
caption: Nothing says romance like vacuum-sealing the living room essentials.

history_entry.core_joke: Boyfriend buys an industrial vacuum sealer as a romantic gesture.
